description: Start an explicitly confirmed, enclave-signed move of this account's own allocated capital. Supports funding Hyperliquid/Lighter/Polymarket from the trading pool and Relay returns from those venues to the owner's Arc Home. Derive and treasury moves are disabled: requires owner approval; not available via API key. confirm:true does not grant that approval. Review preview_capital_move first; preview_home_funding provides separate Home funding quote evidence, not a bound execution ceiling. Users pay the small Arc gas for these capital moves. Requires transfer scope and active capital setup. Retain the move ID and poll get_capital_move for worker reconciliation, transaction hashes, and terminal state. Reuse the same idempotency_key after any uncertain result.

amount_usd.description: Exact reviewed amount, with at most six decimal places.

confirm.description: Must be true after reviewing availability, the amount and the owner-paid costs.

direction.description: fund uses allocated capital; bring_home returns to Arc Home.

idempotency_key.description: Required durable retry key. Preserve this key and the exact request after any timeout.

venue.description: Venue. treasury is allowed only for bring_home.

name: start_capital_move
